title: Unit Event — Happy Enjoy Music! — Episode6 After-Party Invitation

meta.Event Outline: With their new song released, Leo/need looks forward to Jam Fest. Saki, nervous before her first festival, encounters a familiar face...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: What did you think of your first big festival?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: And we all performed so well...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We were actually a little worried at first since not many people had gathered.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: That isn't your fault, since you're still trying to get your name out there. After all, you debuted only just recently.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: However, in terms of raising your name recognition, Leo/need absolutely succeeded in that department today.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But the crowd felt so far away from the stage. That bothered me a little, since I couldn't really see everyone's faces...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But then people started to wave their hands! That was when I knew that they were getting into it!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Also, it sounded like some people were waiting to see us.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: That's right! It definitely felt like we were able to give those who enjoy our music a solid performance.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: And I'm sure those who hadn't heard of Leo/need prior to today now know what your music is about.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hehe...
I hope we get to play at another big venue like this!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Because we need to keep moving forward.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Great show to all of you as well.

rows.Speaker: Mio
rows.Line:
Thank you.
Sorry, but we wanted to pop in and say hi.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: Not only did it seem like you had more fun than usual, the crowd went totally nuts.

rows.Speaker: Saku
rows.Line:
Yeah, it was a great show.
Ours was the best, of course.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Credit where credit's due, anemone was pretty awesome.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
She's right.
I nearly got sucked into the vortex you created.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Me too!
That song just grabbed my heart and never let go!

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: Hey, if you're all free after this, why don't we throw an after-party together?

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: You're still all wound up from the show, right?

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: Plus, we don't get to meet up like this very often. It'd be nice to have more time to talk about music.

rows.Speaker: Mio
rows.Line:
Oh, then... How about that place?
The one we always go to.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We get to throw an after-party at your usual hangout...?! Yes, please! I wanna go!

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: You passed with flying colors today, so please feel free to go and celebrate.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: However, these girls are still in high school, so please make sure they're allowed to go home before it gets too late.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: Anyway, now that you've all received permission...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Can you tell us more about the place we're about to go to?

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: It's a cafe. It's small, but it's a place where true music lovers gather.

rows.Speaker: Mio
rows.Line:
It's such a great place.
They have a grand piano that people can play, everyone there loves talking about music...

rows.Speaker: Mio
rows.Line:
We stop by pretty often after practices.
We even throw most of our after-parties there.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
This is so exciting!
I can't wait to see it!
